core_analysis.summary: The audio captures a customer booking an AC sleeper bus ticket to Anand Vihar, Delhi, for a 6 PM departure. The staff clearly communicated the weekend pricing and collected the booking details. The interaction concluded with an inquiry about the preferred payment method.

findings.title: AC Sleeper Bus Ticket Booked
findings.description: A customer successfully booked an AC sleeper bus ticket to Anand Vihar, Delhi, for a 6 PM departure, arriving at 11 PM.

findings.title: Weekend Fare Explained
findings.description: The staff informed the customer that the ticket price was higher because it was Sunday.

evidence_ref.span_text: aaj Sunday pe kiraya lagega. Shanivar Sunday kiraya mehnga rehta hai.

findings.title: Customer Information Collected
findings.description: The staff collected the customer's name and mobile number for the booking.

evidence_ref.span_text: naam bolo aapka? Ramgopal. Mobile number bolo? [redacted].

findings.title: Payment Method Inquiry
findings.description: At the end of the booking process, the staff asked about the customer's preferred payment method.

highlights.description: Customer inquires about bus type and destination.
Customer requests to book the ticket.
Staff confirms the allocated seat number.

recommendations: Explain weekend pricing policies upfront to manage customer expectations.
Offer a digital payment option for faster transactions.
Confirm all booking details before asking for payment.
Display real-time seat availability and pricing to customers.
